setupHint: Record the income you have received above, then add required expenses and monthly savings.
title: Pouch · Daily budget
tagline: A LITTLE MORE ROOM, EVERY DAY
headline: Make room for today. Plan for tomorrow.
intro: A clear daily recommendation, with your upcoming expenses already considered.
drawerHint: Your records stay on this device. Back them up before resetting Pouch.
plannedPageHint: Plan upcoming expenses and savings goals, then record payments when they happen.
reportsPageHint: Review your spending over days, weeks, months, or a custom range.
budgetPageHint: Record income, required expenses, and the savings you want to set aside.
preferencesPageHint: Choose how Pouch displays amounts and manage safe copies of your records.
explanation: {funds} left in this budget period, including carried funds; {reserved} reserved across {days} remaining days.
ledgerHint: This is a calculated budget, not a bank balance. Recommendations use the current plan and recorded spending. Future income is an estimate.
shortfall: Your plan is short by {amount}. Reduce planned spending or update your budget.
futureHint: Projection for the selected day. Future purchases are saved as plans.
historyHint: Historical daily balance. Upcoming plans affect recommendations from today onward.
dueHint: Later commitments can reduce this recommendation when their projected allowance will not cover them.
tomorrowHint: Spending less than today’s recommendation leaves more money to carry forward. This estimate updates with spending recorded today.
deleted: Deleted. You can undo this change.
noPurchases: No purchases yet. Add your first purchase above.
upcomingHint: Upcoming expenses reserve money. Savings goals use one shared savings forecast and do not reserve their full target amount.
noPlans: No upcoming expenses or savings goals yet.
paidNotice: Payment recorded and its reservation released.
plannedFuture: Saved as a planned expense because its date is in the future.
planHint: Required expenses and monthly savings are set aside before daily spending is calculated. New changes start today unless you choose an advanced date.
dateHint: Displayed dates and date pickers follow your calendar preference.
historicalPlan: Existing budget history starts {date}. New plan changes must start today or later.
currencyHint: Currency labels do not convert amounts. Once money is recorded, start a separate backup and reset to change currency.
overrideHint: Changes the selected day’s budget allocation. It does not add real money or cancel reservations.
defaultAmount: Leave blank to use your plan
reportsHint: Choose your dates, preview the report, then export it as a PDF.
totalPlanned: Unpaid plans due in these dates
reportEmpty: No purchases in the selected dates.
plannedReport: Planned expenses (not included in actual spending)
reportFootnote: Planned amounts are separate from actual spending. Monthly commitments are budget reservations, not proof of payment. Figures use the current saved records.
printHint: Choose “Save as PDF” in the print window.
printUnavailable: PDF export is unavailable. Update the Android app and try again.
printBusy: Finish the current report export first.
printFailed: Could not open PDF export. Please try again.
backupHint: Stored locally. Export a backup before uninstalling or clearing app data.
resetConfirm: Delete all current records and reset the app? Export a backup first.
restoreConfirm: Replace current records with this backup? Export your current data first.
chooseBackup: Choose a location to save your backup.
backupInterrupted: Export was interrupted. Please try again.
backupFailed: Could not save the backup. Choose another location.
pickerUnavailable: No Android document picker is available.
backupBusy: Finish the current backup save first.
noRecovery: No recovery copy is available yet.
unsupportedStorageVersion: This Pouch data was created by a newer app version. Update Pouch to open it.
invalidData: This backup contains invalid or unsupported data. Your saved records have not been changed.
invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount with up to two decimal places.
invalidEntry: Enter a description, a valid date, and an amount greater than zero.
invalidDate: Choose a valid date on or after your start date.
invalidPlan: Complete the monthly plan. Changes to an existing plan must start today or later.
incompleteExpense: Complete or remove every monthly expense row.
invalidReport: Choose a valid period of up to 366 days, or select between 1 and 366 specific days.
backupTooLarge: Backup data must be smaller than 5 MB.
storageUnavailable: Device storage is unavailable. Your changes could not be saved.
storageUnreadable: Saved data could not be read and has not been overwritten. Export it for safekeeping, then restore a valid backup.
saveFailed: Could not save changes. Check available device storage.
totalTooLarge: The total exceeds the supported range.
changedElsewhere: Records changed in another tab. The view has been refreshed.
currencyLocked: Currency cannot change while amounts are recorded. Export a backup and reset first.
futureOverride: Change allowances only for today or a future day.
tomorrowNotice: The date has changed. Today’s recommendation has been refreshed.
recordsImported: Your records are preserved and your budget data has been updated.
aboutDescription: An offline spending planner for daily budgets, purchases, and upcoming expenses.
savingsHint: This amount is set aside before Pouch calculates daily spending.
calendarPreferenceHint: Calendar is based on your app preferences.
salaryCalendarHint: Choose the day you received income. Pouch starts a budget period from each recorded salary.
salaryFuture: Income can only be recorded for today or an earlier date.
salaryRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
advancedDate: Advanced: choose when this change takes effect
advancedDateHint: New changes start today by default. Use another date only to preserve a known schedule.
goalDifference: You need to save {amount} more per month.
goalEnough: Your current savings plan is enough to reach this goal.
goalNoTime: The target date has passed. Update the date or amount to see a new forecast.
goalRemaining: {amount} of planned savings projected after earlier goals
noIncomeYet: Record a received salary above to start a budget period.
noSalaryEntries: No income recorded in this month.
goalAdvanced: This forecast shares your savings across all goals in target date order. Pouch does not track a separate savings balance.
incomeStart: Each recorded salary starts a budget period. If the next salary is late, no estimated income is added.
calendarAutoChanged: Calendar was automatically changed to Persian. You can change it manually from Preferences & data.
noSalaryOnDate: No income is recorded for this date.
goalPaidNotice: Goal purchase saved from planned savings.
storageRecovered: Pouch reopened the last saved recovery copy. Review your latest records.
noSelectedDays: Choose one or more dates for this report.
recommendationHint: This is the amount left for today after recorded purchases and upcoming reservations.
